lines.text: In the dark in the blue
I see you in every face
And I try to let it go
You just pull me back home
Don't forget me don't forget me
Even if it hurts just remember me
Don't forget me don't forget me
Even when I'm gone stay inside me
I still check for your name
And I know it's the end
That you'll come back to me
Don't forget me don't forget me
Even if it hurts just remember me
Don't forget me don't forget me
Even when I'm gone stay inside of me
If I fade into the night
Will you keep me in your light or just let me disappear?
Don't forget me don't forget me
Even if it hurts just remember me
Don't forget me don't forget me
Don't forget me don't forget me
Even when I'm gone stay inside me
I'll be lost in what we've been
